aurin-rift.text: Aurin Rift / Aurin Belt — asteroid mining and survey region at the Verge-facing edge of unstable Lattice space, already associated with Glass Horizon mapping work. Crystalline refractions, mineral haze, irregular corridor geometry and scattered industrial traffic make it visually beautiful but operationally unforgiving.

lattice-fringe.text: Lattice fringe — broken-geometry space beyond ordinary mapped corridors where local tension, timing and reference frames can vary enough that route knowledge must be measured rather than assumed.
